title: Five UAP incidents at Vandenberg, 2003-2005

tellings.quote: Between 2003 and 2005, five UAP incidents occurred at Vandenberg Air Force Base.

plain: Between 2003 and 2005 there were five sightings of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs, at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, according to Jesse Michels. He says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a nuclear missile guard. It would mean unknown objects kept showing up at a base tied to missiles.
